newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hohrin says Lorenzi plans to buy its stake.
newsitem.headline: Hohrin says Lorenzi plans to buy its stake.

text.p: Hohrin Co Ltd confirmed a newspaper report on Tuesday that Lorenzi Diamond Ltd of Israel planned to take a 44 percent stake in the Japanese jewellery importer.

The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday that the Israeli diamond exporter would buy the shares from founder and former chairman of Hohrin, Tadahiko Ura, for about 1.91 billion yen.
Ura currently has a 44 percent stake in Hohrin, a Hohrin spokesman said. Ura was seeking a buyer in hopes that the company would survive in the future, he said.
